# A `Style` field reaches CSS, and an enum member reaches it spelled the way
# CSS spells it.
#
# Two bugs met here. The IR-enum arm that restored `display:flex` wrote the
# member verbatim, so every multi-word member came out camelCase —
# `display:inlineBlock`, `justify-content:spaceBetween` — turning a dropped
# declaration into a wrong one. And seven declared fields had no prop→CSS
# mapping at all and rendered as nothing, two of them added by the change that
# needed them (docs/learn/tour.md styles with fontFamily, cursor and
# borderLeft). internal/htmlutil's TestStyleFieldsAllReachCSS now enumerates
# `Style`'s declared fields against the mapping so a new field cannot repeat it.

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out style.sngl

# A multi-word enum member is the CSS keyword, not the identifier.
grep 'display:inline-block' out/index.html
grep 'flex-direction:row-reverse' out/index.html
grep 'justify-content:space-between' out/index.html
grep 'border-style:dashed' out/index.html
! grep 'inlineBlock' out/index.html
! grep 'rowReverse' out/index.html
! grep 'spaceBetween' out/index.html

# The seven fields that had no mapping.
grep 'min-width:120px' out/index.html
grep 'font-family:Iosevka, monospace' out/index.html
grep 'border-bottom:1px solid #ccc' out/index.html
grep 'border-left:2px solid #000' out/index.html
grep 'border-collapse:collapse' out/index.html
grep 'cursor:pointer' out/index.html

# The lowered path builds the element in JS, and a style struct is not a value
# any DOM sink accepts: passed through it stringified to "[object Object]".
grep 'setAttribute\("style", "cursor:pointer;display:inline-block"\)' out/index.html
! grep 'setAttribute\("style", \{' out/index.html

-- style.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component main {
    var rows list<string> = ["a"]

    window {
        html.div(style = {
            display = Display.inlineBlock,
            flexDirection = FlexDirection.rowReverse,
            justifyContent = Justification.spaceBetween,
            alignItems = Alignment.stretch,
            minWidth = 120,
            fontFamily = "Iosevka, monospace",
            borderBottom = "1px solid #ccc",
            borderLeft = "2px solid #000",
            borderCollapse = "collapse",
            borderStyle = BorderStyle.dashed,
            cursor = "pointer",
        })
        for var r = rows {
            html.span(textContent = r, style = { display = Display.inlineBlock, cursor = "pointer" })
        }
    }
}
